proposal_rules.title: Promote Mandatory Literal Conflict Gate To Universal Prewrite Include
proposal_rules.hypothesis: If mandatory literal-conflict handling is moved into a single explicit prewrite include applied to all write-capable workflows (not only review/check phrasing), the agent will consistently route ambiguous precedence cases to clarification before mutation.
proposal_rules.change: Refactor conflict handling into one deterministic include and require that include before first write for any actionable workflow (including queue/process-inbox variants), plus a final re-check before completion when required artifacts are involved.
